description: Offered to sweep the step and not the man.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Refused him a chair in that state, and priced dinner at threepence.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Spoke six words, rested a gloved hand, and was not named. She went after the others.
name: the lady of the parish

description: Freed the sleeve, said Mistress, and remembered nothing further that he said.
name: William Shakespeare
